name: Mutually homomorphic finite systems are isomorphic
description: Exercise 4.83 (erratum lock): if Z2 is finite and the systems are mutual homomorphic images, the first homomorphism yields an isomorphism. Finiteness of Z1 is not required.

elements.text: Exercise 4.83: Mutually homomorphic finite systems are isomorphic.
Each round trip is a surjective self-map of a finite set, hence injective, so each component homomorphism of the first witness is injective.
Mutual HOM with Z2 finite ⇒ isomorphism via the first witness.
